essence: Rasa of worship-meditation-pleasure swells thousandfold in the Lord.
Remembrance alone cures ignorance-darkness; homage itself belongs to Īśa the fulfiller.
Devotion-jewel fished from the dread sea conquers all; few know the veiled knowable.
Qualityless one known of the knowing, desireless fruit of wants, conquers unborn.
Milk-sea fortune natural to the Lord alone; the blossomer gives bliss in being and non-being.
All-knowing, all-doing, all: nothing left but endless offering.

sections.SUMMARY: Tended worship swells thousand-streamed. One recall heals blackout; the bow itself is already his. Fished from terror waters, love's gem buys everything; the open secret stays hid from most. Want-free and trait-free, the Unborn wins and rewards. Sea-churned riches sit easy on him only; he blooms for release, shields in life and lifelessness, and, all-wise, all-working, all, takes all in endless due.

rasa.dominant: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
rasa.justification: Worship given, grace returned: medicine, jewel, milk, refuge, endless due.
